items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Somebody would come in and say, “I want something by Stravinsky.” I’d get the book out, get the records out. That’s how I learned classical music.

ctx.x: What was your favorite type of music that you liked to listen to?

All kinds of music, because I was geared to that in the music store. Somebody would come in and say, “I want something by Stravinsky.” I’d get the book out, get the records out. That’s how I learned classical music.
Did you learn any other instruments, other than percussion instruments?
